instruction: Place an order for all handheld vacuum cleaners in my amazon wish list.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The wish list contents are unknown up front, so the problem uses representative objects: two handheld-vacuum-cleaner products and one other wish-list product (the agent instantiates one product/quantity object per actual wish-list entry). Knowledge flow: show_wish_list reveals ids/quantities (nullary wish-list-seen, since per-entry effects would need quantified effects), show_product reveals each product's type (product-type-known), show_addresses/show_payment_cards reveal the ids needed by place_order. clear_cart is required before any move and before place_order so the order contains only the moved vacuum cleaners regardless of the unknown initial cart; it can run only once and never after the order. Moves require the target product type and the wish-list quantity (passed explicitly so ordered quantities equal wish-list quantities). (in-cart ?p) is the proxy for 'included in the order': all cart-modifying actions require (not (order-placed)), so the cart state at place_order time equals the final state checked by the goal; the real API empties the cart after ordering. Goal demands the order placed, every vacuum cleaner in the cart, and non-matching items untouched in the wish list. supervisor-complete-task's precondition holds the nullary goal fact (order-placed); the per-product goal literals cannot be named inside the domain, but ordering is still enforced because no cart action can follow place_order and no action can follow complete_task. No answer is needed, so complete_task takes no parameters.
